# little unknown

> little unknown is a product studio founded by Naman Vashistha. It designs, builds and ships apps and software products for the web, mobile and the browser. Tagline: "everything starts unknown".

The studio's belief: every product starts as a little unknown, an open question about something people need. Its work is turning those unknowns into products people rely on. It works by three principles: question everything, build to find out, ship what matters.

The name is written "little unknown" (lowercase, two words). The wordmark is "little_unknown_".

## Pages

- [Home](https://littleunknown.com/): the studio's manifesto, principles and products
- [About](https://littleunknown.com/about/): what the studio does, how it works, who runs it, key facts and FAQ

## Products

- [Calm Chess](https://namanvashistha.com/chess/cozychess/): chess without the pressure, for iPhone and Android ("A kind coach beside you"). A kind coach explains every move in plain words; three opponents from Rookie to Grandmaster plus pass-and-play; no account, no ads, no tracking, fully offline; in English, Hindi and Spanish. Coming to the App Store and Google Play.

## People

- [Naman Vashistha](https://namanvashistha.com): founder; software engineer who designs, builds and ships each product end to end
